description:
Enjoy Lithuanian radio in one tap, with a calm, ad-free listening experience.

Bring Lithuania's favorite radio stations along, without the clutter. Fogwave makes it easy to tune in, listen in the background, and enjoy a clean, ad-free experience with no account or tracking required.

  • Tune in to 14 stations from Lithuania and Latvia, including ZIP FM, Power Hit Radio, Rock FM, LRT Radijas, Žinių radijas, and Latvijas Radio.
  • Keep listening while you use other apps, with controls on your lock screen, notifications, headphones, and Bluetooth.
  • Enjoy your favorite sound with an equalizer, saved settings, loudness boost, and audio presets.
  • Get back to listening easily with auto-reconnect when your stream or network drops.
  • Take radio on the road with Android Auto support.
  • Find stations your way with search, favorites, recently played and similar stations, and see the song that is on air.

Choose a station and press play. Fogwave keeps audio running in the background and saves your equalizer settings for your next session. Its dark, uncluttered design is available in English, Russian, German, Japanese, Lithuanian, and Chinese.

Whether you live in Lithuania, are visiting, or simply enjoy Lithuanian music and radio, Fogwave gives you a straightforward way to listen. It's open source, with no ads, tracking, or account required.

Download Fogwave and tune in to Lithuania.
